```csharp
(OutSystems.Model.UI.Mobile.IMobileFlow mainFlow) => {
    
    /*** creating IMobileScreen 'Help' ***/
    var help2 = mainFlow.CreateScreen("Help");
    var eSpace = mainFlow.GetESpace();
    var registered = eSpace.SystemRoles.OfType<OutSystems.Model.Logic.ISystemRole>().Named("Registered");
    help2.Roles.Add(registered);
    help2.Description = null; // default value
    help2.PageName = "help";
    help2.SetTitle("\"Help\"");
    help2.OnDestroy.Destination = null; // default value
    help2.OnReady.Destination = null; // default value
    help2.OnRender.Destination = null; // default value
    
    var backToTop = help2.CreateScreenAction("BackToTop");
    backToTop.Description = null; // default value
    
    var startNode = backToTop.CreateNode<OutSystems.Model.Logic.Nodes.IStartNode>();
    
    var scrollTop = backToTop.CreateNode<OutSystems.Model.Logic.Nodes.IExecuteClientActionNode>("ScrollTop");
    var scrollTop2 = eSpace.ClientActions.Named("ScrollTop");
    scrollTop.Action = scrollTop2;
    scrollTop.HorizontalPosition = 3200;
    scrollTop.VerticalPosition = 3200;
    startNode.Target = scrollTop;
    
    var endNode = backToTop.CreateNode<OutSystems.Model.Logic.Nodes.IEndNode>();
    scrollTop.Target = endNode;
    help2.OnInitialize.Destination = null; // default value
    
    var layoutMainInstance = help2.CreateWidget<OutSystems.Model.UI.Mobile.Widgets.IMobileBlockInstanceWidget>();
    layoutMainInstance.CustomStyle = null; // default value
    var mOD_DEMO_Layouts = eSpace.References.Named("MOD_DEMO_Layouts");
    var demoLayouts = mOD_DEMO_Layouts.MobileFlows.Named("DemoLayouts");
    var layoutMain = demoLayouts.Nodes.OfType<OutSystems.Model.UI.Mobile.IMobileBlockSignature>().Named("LayoutMain");
    layoutMainInstance.SourceBlock = layoutMain;
    var hasFixedHeader = layoutMain.InputParameters.Named("HasFixedHeader");
    layoutMainInstance.SetArgumentValue(hasFixedHeader, "True");
    
    var placeholderContentWidget = layoutMainInstance.PlaceholdersContent.FirstOrDefault(p => p.Placeholder?.Name == "MainContent");
    var sidebarInstance = placeholderContentWidget.CreateWidget<OutSystems.Model.UI.Mobile.Widgets.IMobileBlockInstanceWidget>();
    sidebarInstance.CustomStyle = null; // default value
    var commonFlow = eSpace.MobileFlows.Named("Common");
    var sidebar = commonFlow.Nodes.OfType<OutSystems.Model.UI.Mobile.IMobileBlock>().Named("Sidebar");
    sidebarInstance.SourceBlock = sidebar;
}
```
